mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coupon (user_id, coupon_template_id, status, effective_start_time, effective_end_time, status_update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{couponTemplateId}, #{status}, #{effectiveStartTime}, #{effectiveEndTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_coupon WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM user_coupon WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 3 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 3, order_no = #{orderNo}, lock_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 1, use_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 3
UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 0, order_no = NULL, lock_time = NULL, status_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 3

UPDATE user_coupon uc JOIN coupon_template ct ON ct.id = uc.coupon_template_id SET uc.status = 2, uc.status_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE uc.status = 0 AND COALESCE(uc.effective_end_time, ct.use_end_time, ct.end_time) < NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT uc.id AS userCouponId, uc.coupon_template_id AS couponTemplateId, uc.status AS userStatus, uc.order_no AS orderNo, uc.receive_time AS receiveTime, uc.use_time AS useTime, uc.lock_time AS lockTime, COALESCE(uc.effective_start_time, ct.use_start_time, ct.start_time) AS effectiveStartTime, COALESCE(uc.effective_end_time, ct.use_end_time, ct.end_time) AS effectiveEndTime, ct.shop_id AS shopId, ct.name, ct.type, ct.amount, ct.min_amount AS minAmount, ct.max_discount_amount AS maxDiscountAmount, ct.status AS templateStatus FROM user_coupon uc JOIN coupon_template ct ON ct.id = uc.coupon_template_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = #{status} ORDER BY uc.receive_time DESC, uc.id DESC

SELECT uc.id AS userCouponId, uc.user_id AS userId, u.username, uc.status AS userStatus, uc.order_no AS orderNo, uc.receive_time AS receiveTime, uc.use_time AS useTime, uc.lock_time AS lockTime, COALESCE(uc.effective_end_time, ct.use_end_time, ct.end_time) AS effectiveEndTime FROM user_coupon uc JOIN coupon_template ct ON ct.id = uc.coupon_template_id JOIN user u ON u.id = uc.user_id WHERE uc.coupon_template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY uc.receive_time DESC, uc.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_coupon WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND coupon_template_id = #{templateId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_coupon WHERE coupon_template_id = #{templateId}
